purpose: Teach: カーター/ジョブズ/ナイジェリア/アルメニア/プラトン/ユング/ラテンアメリカ/ローマ法王

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがカーター政権時代を懐かしまれた
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, your father used to reminisce about the Carter years.
lines.style: Gentle, reflective opening. Soft voice reaching back into memory. Measured pace, like tracing old footsteps. Warm but distant.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、晩年ジョブズのスピーチに感動されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, and he was so moved by those Jobs speeches in his later years, wasn't he?
lines.style: Bright affirmation, then a gentle redirect. Testing whether he remembers this detail. Warm, slightly playful—the intimacy of long marriage.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがナイジェリア駐在のお話されたわ
lines.en: Gran, he used to tell me about those years he spent stationed in Nigeria.
lines.style: Continuing the thread, as if turning a page. Quiet certainty. The slight lift of 「わ」 at the end—offering this memory, not insisting on it.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、アルメニア大虐殺の歴史本を読まれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And he read so deeply into those histories—the Armenian genocide, all of it. You remember?
lines.style: Gently correcting the thread, bringing weight to it. Not interrogating—just confirming they share this memory. Warm voice holding something serious.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがプラトンの対話篇に親しまれた
lines.en: He loved Plato, too. Those dialogues—he knew them when he was still young.
lines.style: Voice settling deeper. Admiring, almost reverent. Slow delivery. The intimacy of knowing someone's intellectual loves.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、ユング心理学を独学されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: He taught himself Jung, didn't he? All on his own.
lines.style: Soft pride in the observation. Wondering aloud with him, not at him. Warmth carries recognition of a man's quiet self-education.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがラテンアメリカ音楽を集められた
lines.en: And his collection of Latin American music—he had such an ear for it.
lines.style: Almost tender now. Voice opening up slightly. Lingering on the memory like hearing a favorite song again. Slower, letting it breathe.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、ローマ法王訪日のニュースをご覧になったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: He watched that papal visit to Japan with such interest, didn't he?
lines.style: Closing the circle with warmth and gentleness. Voice near his ear. A small, intimate smile in the tone. Letting the final memory settle between them.
